purpose: The presence dot on an Avatar: online, busy, away, offline or do-not-disturb, with a Surface/page edge that separates it from the photo.

notFor.case: A status label anywhere other than an avatar.
Any use without an avatar under it.

Status=do-not-disturb.visual: Status/critical/surface-solid dot with a Status/critical/on-solid bar.

a11y.role: img labelled with the presence ("Online"); the app can override the label
notes: Never rely on colour alone: the label names the presence. The outside edge is Surface/page.

openQuestions: Busy and do-not-disturb share Status/critical/surface-solid; only the bar tells them apart. Is that readable at the 6 px xs size?
